# SoT reflection table

`sot_reflection.txt` is embedded in SOTModel.exe (resource 103) and read by `src/ue/SotReflection.cpp`. The Blueprint
decompiler uses it for the C++ names of native classes (`AActor`, `UKismetSystemLibrary`), the signatures of native
UFunctions (parameter names, const / out references, static), the types of native members (to find the class a call
goes to, e.g. `Mesh->GetMaterials()` on a Character) and the values of native enums.

It is generated by `gen_sot_reflection.py` from two SDK dumps of the game made by reading the running process's
reflection data (no game code is included, only names and types):

- `old-sot/investigation/native_code/depot/sdk_ufunction_signature_index.json` and `sdk_class_field_index.json`:
  the `depot_2020` build, the same one whose files SOTModel reads. Its signatures keep `const` and out parameters
  (written as `T*` for non-objects, `&` for in/out structs), but list the out parameters last.
- `sot-dump/SoT_2.152.3728.4_steam_all/SDK`: a newer build. It gives the class hierarchy, the enums, and the
  parameter blocks whose field order is the declaration order (the order Blueprint bytecode passes arguments in).

Signatures come from the depot_2020 dump, reordered to the newer dump's parameter order when both list the same
parameters; when they don't and the function has out parameters, the line is flagged `u` (argument positions
unknown) and the decompiler does not name its arguments. Functions only in the newer dump have no out information.

```
python -I gen_sot_reflection.py <old-sot/investigation> <sot-dump/SoT_..._steam_all/SDK> sot_reflection.txt
```

Line format (tab separated):

```
C  <name> <PrefixedName> <super name>
F  <owner> <function> <flags: s static, c const, u out-parameter positions unknown> <return type> <mode|type|name>...
P  <class> <member> <C++ type>     (object, interface, class, enum and bool members of native classes;
                                   native structs by their F name, inherited members included)
E  <enum> <value=Enumerator>...
```

`mode` is `v` (by value), `r` (const reference) or `o` (out).
